functions.name: init
functions.description: Starts showing avatars in the message list of all open and future tabs.

functions.name: setAvatars
functions.description: Delivers avatars (email -> data URL, or null if none was found).

functions.name: clearAvatars
functions.description: Forgets all known avatars so they are requested again.

events.name: onAvatarsNeeded
events.description: Fired when senders without a contact photo and with no known avatar are shown.
